decision: 103 Canonical Nodes remain atomic knowledge authority; public Articles may group only adjacent or tightly coupled mechanisms without changing Node identity.

classificationDefinitions.ARTICLE_PRIMARY_STANDALONE: Node owns a one-node customer Article.
classificationDefinitions.ARTICLE_PRIMARY_GROUPED: Node is the primary owner of a multi-node customer Article.
classificationDefinitions.ARTICLE_SUPPORTING_GROUPED: Node is fully covered inside a grouped Article and does not create a duplicate standalone Article.
